dimensions.summary: Shadow contracts and consumer adapters exist, but production CLI commands still call the released composer. Package-primary-with-compare is fail-closed until an explicit replacement decision.

The trusted required corpus is one committed Node service plus a small fixture. Large, polyglot, generated-heavy and multi-project repositories remain optional local observations, not release evidence.
In-process incremental APIs are not a persistent installed-CLI speedup. Production CLI does not consume a trusted change journal for package-primary rebuilds.
Shadow execution stays read-only. Package-primary invocation fails closed and cannot silently fall back to the released composer.
G8 shadow comparison remains read-only, offline and prohibited from mutating canonical generations.
Linux/macOS/Windows G8 real-workspace matrix is a CI PR-candidate on commit 2cd4266. Candidate reports are not retained G8 admission or package-primary evidence.
The package remains private. npm publication and a central-CLI runtime dependency stay prohibited.

Semantic shadow comparison exists for the committed Node corpus. Package-primary production results, installed-consumer gates and a classified difference ledger for the required broader corpus do not.
Shadow mapping v2 and compatibility renderers do not fabricate proof. Historical G7 admission remains the authorizing prior closure.
Rollback still means the released CLI composer. A package-primary last-valid generation and tested rollback window cannot exist until package-primary is admitted.
This blocked closure is the versioned G8 transition ledger. Historical shadow-only audit remains immutable and does not admit G9.
Internal distribution and publication refusal are unchanged. Green CI is not npm publication or G8 replacement.

checks.evidence: G8 plan, registry and consumer inventory still authorize shadow comparison only.

refuseUnadmittedPackagePrimaryExecution throws GRAPH_PACKAGE_PRIMARY_NOT_ADMITTED. executePackagePrimaryWithCompare compares an independent released-CLI graph to a package candidate, keeps packagePrimary false, and is not called from production CLI composers.
GitHub Actions run 35350476249 on PR 65 verified Linux/macOS/Windows G8 real-workspace matrix for 2cd426679366917bf55c03cde2d610eddd897323 as a shadow PR-candidate with admitted=false.
Checkpoint package-primary-replacement-decision remains planned. No versioned replacement decision exists.
CLI index, workspace model and workspace contract still call buildWorkspaceKnowledgeGraph. The consumer adapter is not the production producer.
nextStageAuthorized remains false. Legacy composers must not be removed.

remainingRisks: Production CLI commands still call buildWorkspaceKnowledgeGraph; package-primary is not the graph producer.

GRAPH_CONSUMER_PACKAGE_PRIMARY remains false. executePackagePrimaryWithCompare is a fail-closed comparison entry that never publishes package graph truth; production consumers still call the released CLI composer.
Trusted required cross-platform corpus is only committed-node-service; large, polyglot, generated-heavy and multi-project repositories are optional local observations.
Production CLI does not persist a trusted change journal for incremental package rebuilds.
G8 real-workspace matrix admission remains admitted=false and nextStageAuthorized=false.
G9 nextStageAuthorized remains false; legacy composers must not be removed.

approval.rule: G8 replacement requires package-primary-with-compare evidence on a tested commit plus an explicit admission record. This blocked closure must not be relabelled approved to make CI green.
